title: Verified physics concept bridges
attribution: Editorial paraphrases of OpenStax educational sources; original uploaded attributions retained separately.

claims.statement: Section 5.3: external forces sum vectorially; acceleration follows net external force and is inversely proportional to mass.
Section 2.2: mean molecular translational energy is 3kBT/2; monatomic ideal-gas internal energy sums those energies.
Section 7.1: ionic compounds consist of charged ions held by electrostatic attraction; ions form through electron loss or gain.
Section 6.3, The Quantum-Mechanical Model of an Atom: squared wavefunction magnitude gives the spatial probability distribution.
Section 16.2, Nuclear Fusion: hydrogen fusion products have lower mass, with the difference released as energy.
